Name: SD's Mushroom Dig Spot for 1.6 - Seasonal or Non
Author: sashaldystauns
Description:
[size=3]Get ready for a big, colorful mushroom that makes finding the artifacts (the old dig spot) and the new seeds (the new dig spot in 1.6) much easier + it's seasonal or not (you can choose one)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5ZdBQv6.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod offers a retexture of the dig spot, making it much easier to see. [/size]
[*][size=3]Both versions (Seasonal and Non-Seasonal) are highly configurable![/size]
[*][size=3]There are 8 colors available for the cap and 3 colors for the stalk.﻿﻿﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HudgTlZ.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]You can enable changes for only one of the dig spots, enable both, or disable both.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can customize the cap color for each dig spot, making them different or the same.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can customize the stalk color for each dig spot, making them different or the same.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can customize the cap color for each dig spot in each season (seasonal version only).[/size]
[*][size=3]You can customize the stalk color for each dig spot in each season (seasonal version only).﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q4o3aNa.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Make sure you've got the latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]While not required, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ is highly recommended (you can make changes in-game).[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip this mod into your Mods folder (you can choose only one of two versions). [/size]
[*][size=3]Launch the game with this mod once to generate a config file if you prefer to manually adjust the configs.[/size]
[*][size=3]Now you're ready to go and discover all the new seeds.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DpQRWUi.png[/img]
✔ Any custom map mods or mods that expand the map. (e.g., [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Reimagined 3[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3679]Capitalist Dream Farm[/url])
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IRcHegE.png[/img]
✘ Any mods that change the appearance of dig spots, whether they're from UI mods or recolor mods.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gm0xiBI.png[/img]
✔ You can either remove the dig spot part from its content.json file, or, unfortunately, stop using this mod.
✔ Alternatively, you can replace the dig spot asset in other mods with this one. Feel free to customize it for your personal use.
✔ If you're unsure how to remove the dig spot part from your other mods or if you're concerned it might not work, let me know in the comments, and I'll help you out. ^^

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F32EG1g.png[/img]
1.0.0 - Initial release of the mod.
1.0.1 - Renamed the folder from "asset" to "assets".
2.0.0 - Recoded to fix cap issue with bigger mushroom in the new dig spot 1.6.
         - Adjusted the new dig spot animation image.
         - Added 2 new colors.
3.0.0 - Added 2 new cap colors.
         - Making the stalk color configurable (added 3 new stalk colors).
         - Introducing seasonal version.
3.0.1 - Added TV Text Changes, it make the TV mention mushrooms instead of worms (inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21638]Theoddon's TV Patch[/url])

[/size][quote][size=3]If you enjoy this mod, please kindly consider giving it an endorsement. It will mean a lot to me <3[/size][/quote][size=3]
Hey there, I'm Sashaldystauns.
I'm just starting out in the world of modding, and this marks my debut mod! If you encounter any issues, I apologize in advance. Yet, I'm still learning the ropes here. Your support along the way means a lot to me! ^^

P.S. English isn't my first language, but hopefully, you'll still be able to understand what I've written here (I'm using a translator app).[/size]
